content: अतिरिक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Surpassed, excelled; सर्वातिरिक्तसारेण <ls>R. 1. 14</ls> strength exceeding that of all creatures; सुतजन्मातिरिक्तेन महोत्सवेन <ls>K. 137</ls> surpassing the birth of a son. .²2 Redundant, superfluous, remaining over and above; परिपूरितहृदयातिरिक्तहर्षमिव <ls>K. 66</ls> not contained in the heart. .²3 Excessive, exuberant. .²4 Unequalled, unsurpassed; supreme, elevated समश्नुवानाः सहसा ऽतिरिक्तताम् <ls>Ki. 14. 33</ls> being raised up or elevated. .²5 Different (generally व्यतिरिक्त in this sense, <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²6 Quite empty.
